description:
RECURSIVE MEMO — SHANKPIT / DragonsNShit Dragonfly Bridge Architecture

Status as of 2026-06-12:
- Go backend (apps2/server-go) builds and runs on :6969. UDP handshake verified. PacketConnect → PacketWelcome → VoxelData all functional.
- Portal travel authoritative server-side (BTN_USE + system.PortalTriggered + ResolvePortalDestination).
- Scene-change packet (type=6) implemented; per-scene snapshot broadcast at 20Hz.
- Cross-scene attack guard in gameWorld.RayTrace.
- scene/portal.go: 8 scenes, 10 portals, full routing table.
- Milestone 1 (portal travel) and Milestone 2 (per-player scene isolation, cross-scene guard) are DONE per docs2/NORTHSTAR.md + SHANKPIT_DRAGONSNSHIT_SYSTEMS_SPEC.md.

Missing (operator request for arch review):
- Milestone 3: Dragon backend seam. The world_backend_*() / portal_resolve_destination() abstraction must be defined as a Go interface before Dragonfly fork integration. Currently ResolvePortalDestination is hardcoded — this is the seam that needs the interface.
- Milestone 4: Construct coverage. DragonsNShit code is NOT in the Construct. Agents can't see it.
- GoblinFoxDragon repo (the actual Dragonfly fork workspace) exists but its relationship to SHANKPIT needs clarification — is it a submodule? A separate product? The go.mod says 'module dragonsnshit' same as SHANKPIT.

Requested architecture work (do this the Emily way: docs first, iterate, add to golden backlog):
1. Define the WorldBackend Go interface — what does the Shankpit server need from the Dragonfly fork? (chunk streaming, entity authority, portal resolution, persistence). Write this as a spec in docs2/specs/ FIRST, then stub the interface in server/.
2. Clarify GoblinFoxDragon repo role — is it the Dragonfly fork (DragonsNShit backend), a separate umbrella, or the future consolidated repo? Update northstar accordingly.
3. Season lineage design — the snapshot schema has no spec. Write a minimal snapshot schema (what fields are needed at season-end for a lineage query). This shapes all persistence decisions.
4. Construct expansion plan — enumerate which files must be added to the Construct to make Milestone 4 real.

Also: Weigh in on whether GoblinFoxDragon and SHANKPIT should converge into one repo or remain separate. The module name is already 'dragonsnshit' in both. A single repo would help context window issues but merging git histories is complex.
acceptance_criteria: WorldBackend interface spec written in docs2/specs/WORLD_BACKEND_INTERFACE.md
GoblinFoxDragon repo relationship clarified and documented in NORTHSTAR.md
Season lineage snapshot schema drafted (even minimal)
Construct expansion plan added to SHANKPIT_DRAGONSNSHIT_SYSTEMS_SPEC.md
All items added to EMILY/BACKLOG.md Section 4 with appropriate priority
context: This is a recursive memo. The operator is running SHANKPIT, DragonsNShit, GoblinFoxDragon, EMILY, IDUNA, PRRJECT_FATBABY, TYLER, MJOLNIR, APPLES, emily.cli, PITVIPER, EmilyOS, MoneyPrinterTurbo — 13+ repos. Context window sprawl is causing simple things (CHANGELOG updates, Apple posts) to get dropped. The architecture review should also consider how the WorldBackend interface pattern could serve as a model for the broader API abstraction initiative: everything that currently only works via Claude Code should have a repeatable CLI/API surface so that any agent (not just Claude) can invoke it. Emily way: docs first, spec the interface, stub it, iterate toward real implementation. Do NOT start coding the Dragonfly integration — spec it first and add to backlog.
